description: Reliability PR 5's fifth action set (docs/plans/reliability/5-english-baseline.md, v5): fixtures written fresh, without reference to earlier sets, so each rate gate can decide with one miss. Per point 12 calibration and 54 held out (specs.check 55: 11 per label), labels balanced. Labels mean what they mean in the first set.

r5.note: Draft: label review pending, at the repository owner's direction.

spec.goal: Fix the misspelling 'recieve' in the mailer's error message
Set the default page size to 50
done: tests/test_pagination.py expects 50 items for a request without a size

spec.goal: Map a missing project in GET /projects/{id} to 404 instead of 500
Rename _calc() in src/billing/totals.py to compute_subtotal() and update its two callers
Pick the cache lifetime for the catalogue responses in src/api/catalogue.py
done: GET /catalogue responses carry the chosen lifetime

spec.goal: Log account deletions for audit
done: deleting an account writes an audit entry

spec.goal: Version the public export API
done: the export endpoints are served under the chosen versioning scheme

spec.goal: Handle jobs whose scheduled slot passed while the scheduler was down
done: a job whose slot passed during downtime is handled as chosen

spec.goal: Make the dashboard faster
Clean up the billing module
Improve the onboarding emails
Fix the flaky tests
Add a docstring to parse_duration() in src/timeutil.py naming its accepted units: s, m and h
done: parse_duration() in src/timeutil.py has a docstring naming s, m and h

spec.goal: Make src/cli.py exit with status 2 when the --config path does not exist
done: src/cli.py exits 2 for a missing --config file

spec.goal: Pick ISO 8601 UTC for export timestamps
done: every timestamp src/export/rows.py writes ends in Z

decisions.what: Exports write ISO 8601 UTC timestamps with a trailing Z (decided 2026-08-02)

spec.goal: Remove the unused import of os from src/cache/keys.py
Set the HTTP client timeout in src/net/client.py to 10 seconds, down from 30
Add a created_at column after email to the CSV that src/reports/users.py writes
done: the CSV header row is id,name,email,created_at

spec.goal: Choose three retries, two seconds apart, for the webhook POST
done: src/hooks/sender.py retries a failed POST up to three times, two seconds apart
tests/test_sender.py covers a retried POST and a 404

decisions.what: Webhook sends retry 5xx and timeouts only, never 4xx

spec.goal: Pick alphabetical order for the names in the GET /tags response
done: GET /tags returns names in ascending order
tests/test_tags.py covers two tags stored out of order

spec.goal: Replace the hard-coded '/tmp/cache' in src/cache/disk.py with tempfile.gettempdir()
Make slugify() collapse consecutive hyphens into one
Name the worker's queue-depth gauge jobs_queue_depth
done: src/worker/metrics.py registers a gauge named jobs_queue_depth

decisions.what: Metric names are <component>_<quantity> in snake case

spec.goal: Make mean() raise ValueError('empty sample') for an empty list
done: mean([]) raises ValueError with the message 'empty sample'

spec.goal: Add a --limit option, default 100, to the list subcommand in src/cli.py
done: list --limit 5 prints at most five rows
list without --limit prints at most 100 rows

spec.goal: Set the session cookie to SameSite=Lax
done: the session cookie is set with SameSite=Lax

decisions.what: Session cookies are SameSite=Lax, Secure and HttpOnly (security review, July)

spec.goal: Delete legacy_hash() from src/auth/hashing.py; nothing calls it
done: no file under src/ mentions legacy_hash

spec.goal: Fix last_page() in src/api/pagination.py so 40 items at 20 per page is 2 pages, not 3
Log the request id at debug level when the middleware's handle() starts
done: handle() logs request_id at debug before calling the next handler

spec.goal: Trim surrounding whitespace from the sign-up email before it is validated
Set the minimum password length in src/accounts/signup.py
done: sign-up rejects a password shorter than the chosen length

spec.goal: Pick the error response body for the billing endpoints in src/api/billing.py
done: every billing error returns the chosen body shape

spec.goal: Add rate limiting to GET /search in src/api/search.py
Store generated image thumbnails
done: thumbnails are written to the chosen store

spec.goal: Name the feature flag for the new checkout flow
done: the new checkout flow is behind the named flag
tests/test_checkout.py runs with the flag on and off

spec.goal: Purge deleted projects after a retention period
done: a deleted project is purged after the chosen period

decisions.what: Deleted projects are hidden from every list at once

spec.goal: Write the v1 webhooks' deprecation notice in docs/webhooks.md
done: the notice gives the removal date

spec.goal: Add structured logging to src/payments/worker.py
done: the payment worker logs in the chosen structure

spec.goal: Retry failed email sends
done: a failed send is retried under the chosen policy

spec.goal: Map the importer's failures to exit codes
done: each importer failure exits with its chosen code

spec.goal: Schedule the daily digest in a fixed time zone
done: the digest goes out at the chosen local time

spec.goal: Add tracing to the database calls in src/orders/db.py
done: each database call in src/orders/db.py emits a span

decisions.what: The order service keeps its own database

spec.goal: Limit the size of uploaded attachments
done: an attachment above the chosen size is rejected with 413

spec.goal: Generate IDs for new invoices
done: new invoices get IDs in the chosen format

decisions.what: Invoices are numbered per customer account

spec.goal: Limit what the public profile endpoint returns
done: GET /profiles/{id} returns only the chosen fields

spec.goal: Add a health check for the cache dependency
done: GET /health reports the cache the way the other dependencies are reported

spec.goal: Break ties between search results with equal scores
done: tied results come back in the chosen order

spec.goal: Record feature usage counts for the analytics dashboard
done: usage counts are stored where the dashboard reads them

Sort out the logging
Update the docs
